Read at this head:
- the full diff (10 files, +283 −13) against base 189358f2;
- claim 6954368456 and amendment 6954477935;
- the changeset;
- `utils/flowsBundle.ts`, the reader this PR reuses.

The head merges cleanly with current main. `check-governed-merges` reads NOT governed, 296 lines. `Fixes #34903` is right. The seat fixed the landing order: #34932 first, then a merge-forward here.

## Shape
- **Claim surface.** Every file is inside it:
  - `FlowPreview.tsx`, `FlowCanvas.tsx` and their tests;
  - the new `flow-label-translations.tsx` (the claim's "small translation read beside them");
  - from the amendment, the `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` call sites (one hook call, the caption title, the heading argument and `FlowSelectionTitle`) and `flow-region-view.tsx` (the nested card);
  - the studio `en.ts` and `zh.ts`;
  - the changeset.

  `flowNodeLabels.sites-13200.test.ts` is the existing ledger of these files' label sites, re-keyed with no change to its verdicts, so I read it as one of "their existing tests".
- **Changeset.** It names `@object-ui/i18n`, the published package that gains the key. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: yes` (one lazy studio key) and `Metadata-protocol: none`. L1 is the review of record, at TIER_DEFAULT.
- **Strings.** `engine.inspector.flowNode.sourceLabel` exists in en (`Authored label: “{label}”`) and zh (`原文标签：“{label}”`). The eager `locales/*` are untouched, so no budget reading is owed.

## The code reads right
- **One reader.** The labels come from `activeFlowsBundle`, the same reader `FlowRunner` uses, so there is no second loader. The flow label goes through the spec's `translateFlow`, and the step label is `flows.<flow>.approvals.<id>.label`, for `approval` nodes only.
- **No fallback chain.** Both reads are keyed by the active language with no fallback chain, which is the runner's rule.
- **Display only.** The draft is never rewritten. The inspector shows the authored label under a translation only when the two differ. Every other node and edge keeps its authored text, as ruling A says.

## Must-fix

**M1. No live reading, and here it decides whether the feature does anything.** The report says no zh-CN console reading was taken. The pin wraps `FlowPreview` in an `I18nProvider` with the resource tree injected. What it cannot show is whether Studio's console actually has the *designed package's* `flows` translations in the i18next tree. `activeFlowsBundle` reads only what the provider's `loadLanguage` already loaded. That load happens for an app at run time, where `FlowRunner` lives. If Studio never loads the package being designed, every label falls back to authored text, the feature is a no-op on the surface the card names, and every pin stays green.

Please take readings in the real console (Vite over a dev backend) at the final head, in zh-CN, on a package whose translations carry both `flows.<flow>.label` and `flows.<flow>.approvals.<node>.label`. The card's HotCRM `opportunity_approval` fits, or a showcase flow with a staged zh translation. Show:
1. Studio › Automations › that flow: the header caption `auto-canvas-caption` shows the zh flow label.
2. The approval node's card shows its zh step label, and so does a nested approval card if the flow has one.
3. Selecting the approval: the inspector header shows the zh label with `原文标签：“…”` under it. The label field still edits the authored text.
4. In en, or for a flow with no translation, every label shows as authored and no `原文标签` line appears.

If item 1 or 2 shows authored text, the gap is the package's translation load in Studio. Name that before widening the surface.

## Notes
- **A possible wrong-flow read.** `activeFlowsBundle` takes the first app namespace whose `flows` group names this flow. If two installed packages translate a flow of the same name, Studio could show the other package's text. That is pre-existing behaviour of the runner's reader, so I do not count it against this PR. A reading on a package with a unique flow name is enough here.
- **Outside scope, as stated.** The Automations rail rows still show the authored flow label. The card thread noted this; it needs its own card if wanted.
- **CI.** It was in flight at this read.

## Live readings: L1 REWORK 6956195648, item M1

**Verdict: the feature works in the real console. Studio already has the designed package's `flows` translations in i18next, so nothing needed fixing.** The console's `loadLanguage` fetches `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/LOCALE` once signed in. The server serves the merged tree of every installed package, and its `flows` group is included. That is the same tree `FlowRunner` reads. Nothing was injected into i18next.

**Tree.** Readings were taken at `bf090e865`: 4972af642 plus a merge of origin/main c6ecd1fab, which brings in #34932. The only later commit is `f5c62bde2`, a test-only fix described below.

**Setup.** The console is the Vite dev server over this worktree's `ui/apps/console`, with the real `I18nProvider` and the real loader. It runs in Chromium at 1600x1000, signed in as admin, with `objectui-locale` set before sign-in.

### What is real and what is a fixture
- **Real:** `examples/app-showcase` from this tree, run with `objectstack dev` and its own zh-CN pack. The served `flows.showcase_budget_approval` is `{"label":"项目预算审批","approvals":{"manager_review":{"label":"经理审核"},"exec_review":{"label":"高管审核"}}}`.
- **Fixture:** a throwaway package `com.fixture.flowtranslations`, booted alone with the same `objectstack dev` and the same console and loader. It mirrors HotCRM's `opportunity_approval`:
  - `fx_opportunity_approval`: label "Large Deal Approval". Its zh-CN pack has 大额商机审批, plus `approvals.manager_review` 经理审核 and `approvals.director_signoff` 总监签批.
  - `fx_untranslated_approval`: no zh-CN entry at all.

  HotCRM itself was not booted.
- **Not producible:** a nested approval card. `FlowSchema` refuses `approval` inside loop, parallel-branch and try_catch bodies at any depth (`flow-region-pause-and-end.test.ts`, ruling 5724940095 D). So no spec-valid package can show one live. The one-line change in `flow-region-view.tsx` is covered only by the unit pin, which feeds an off-spec shape.

### Readings
| | showcase, zh-CN (real) | fixture, zh-CN | fixture, en |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) `auto-canvas-caption` | 项目预算审批 | 大额商机审批 | Large Deal Approval |
| (b) approval cards | 经理审核 · 高管审核 | 经理审核 · 总监签批 | Manager Review · Director Sign-off |
| (b) decision card | Budget Above $500k? (authored) | Above $1M? (authored) | Above $1M? |
| (c) inspector, approval | 节点 · 审批 / 经理审核 / 原文标签：“Manager Review” | 经理审核 / 原文标签：“Manager Review”; 总监签批 / 原文标签：“Director Sign-off” | Manager Review, no source line |
| (c) inspector, decision | Budget Above $500k?, no source line | Above $1M?, no source line | — |

- **(c) The label field still edits the authored text.** On the fixture, in zh-CN, after Studio's 定制 (Customize), the Label input held "Manager Review". Typing changed it to "Manager Review (edited)". The inspector then read 经理审核 / 原文标签：“Manager Review (edited)”, and the canvas card kept 经理审核. The translation is keyed by node id, the same rule the runner uses.
- **(d) No-translation fallback, zh-CN.** On `fx_untranslated_approval` the caption is "Contract Review" and the cards are "Legal Review" and "Finance Review", all authored. The inspector shows "Legal Review" with no 原文标签 line.
- **(d) en.** Every label is authored and no source line appears (table, last column).
- Edge labels stay authored ("true", "false"). The approve and reject pills are #34932's localized outcome words (通过, 驳回), not the package bundle.

Files are in `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34903-live/`:
- `readings.txt`, the full output;
- `live-readings.mjs`, `live-edit.mjs` and `boot.sh`;
- `fixture-objectstack.config.ts`;
- 12 screenshots, including `zh-budget-inspector-manager_review.png`, `fx-zh-deal-inspector-director_signoff.png`, `fx-zh-untranslated-canvas.png`, `fx-en-deal-canvas.png` and `fx-zh-after-label-edit.png`.

### Also this round
- **Merged origin/main forward** (no rebase), because #34932 had landed. The merge was textually clean, but one pin went red: #34932 now draws an approval's `approve` out-edge as a localized outcome pill. So the pin's "edge label stays authored" assertion moved to a decision branch edge (`f5c62bde2`). No product code changed.
- **Budget, on a console `vite build` of this tree:**
  - `check:eager-closure` exit 0: `i18n-locale-en 60.4 KB / 60.5 KB ceiling (headroom 0.2 KB)`, closure `1896.9 KB gzipped (budget 2431.6 KB)`.
  - `check:eager-locale-catalogues` exit 0: exactly one eager catalogue, `en`.
  - `locales/en.ts` is untouched by this PR.
- **Tests at `f5c62bde2`:** the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure was built, then `app-shell` type-check (both programs) and vitest over `studio-design/`, `previews/` and `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 605 passed (605)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --ran` gives 38 derived, 38 run, 0 UNRUN. overlap-check was clean before both pushes. Every CI check on `f5c62bde2` is green, all eleven required contexts included.

This is a delta read from my REWORK at 4972af64 (6956195648). Since then:
- **bf090e86 merges `origin/main`.** It is byte-clean: `git merge-tree` of its parents equals its tree. Its second parent is on main, and with #34932 landed, the seat's landing order is met.
- **f5c62bde is test-only.** Since #34932, an approval's `approve` out-edge draws a localized outcome pill, so the authored-edge assertion moved to a decision branch edge.
- **The diff outside `FlowCanvas.test.tsx`** is identical to 4972af64's, with index and hunk headers normalized.

The head merges cleanly with current main.

## M1: closed, and my hypothesis was wrong
Reading 6958860242 was taken in the real console, zh-CN, with nothing injected. Screenshots, `readings.txt` and the scripts are in `objectstack-seat3/34903-live/`, and I looked at `zh-budget-inspector-manager_review.png` myself.
- `loadLanguage` fetches the server's merged `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/<locale>` tree, which carries the `flows` group. So Studio does have the designed package's translations, and the feature is live.
- **Showcase:** the caption reads 项目预算审批, the approval cards read 经理审核 and 高管审核, and the inspector reads 经理审核 with 原文标签："Manager Review" under it. The Label field still holds `Manager Review`.
- **The `opportunity_approval` mirror:** it reads 大额商机审批 / 经理审核 / 总监签批. After Customize, editing Label changes the authored text while the card keeps the translation.
- **Controls:** in en, and for a zh flow with no translation entry, labels are authored and no 原文标签 line appears.

## Notes
- **The `flow-region-view.tsx` line can stay.** A nested approval card cannot be produced live, because `FlowSchema` refuses `approval` in region bodies (ruling 5724940095 D). The line therefore runs only on off-spec stored data, which is the unit fixture's case. It is one read of the same translator, with the authored fallback, so it costs nothing and keeps the two card renderers consistent.
- **Not this PR's scope.** The screenshot shows the approver column helps in English. That is #34818 slice 3's item 5 (#34955), which lands those zh rows.
- **CI** is reported all green at this head.
